name: Call of Water

angles.text: As a shaman, you undertake a rite of passage to attune with the water spirits and earn the Water Totem. It shows harmony and mastery over elemental forces.
As an Alliance shaman, you travel from Loch Modan into Westfall to purify its corrupted waters.

faq.answer: For shamans seeking communion with the water elements, the Call of Water is a spiritual trial. You cleanse the corruption at Stendel's Pond in Westfall and use its old shrine to summon a cleansed water spirit and seek your Water Totem.
faq.q: What is the Call of Water quest?

faq.answer: Norric gives you the Call of Water in Loch Modan. He instructs you in elemental rites, provides special potions, and guides you in cleansing corrupted elemental waters.
Stendel's Pond lies just outside Moonbrook in southwestern Westfall. Once a pure spring, it has grown still and murky under dark, corrupting influences.
You cleanse Stendel's Pond by defeating the corrupting presence and taking its bracers. Place them on the old shrine with the remaining potion drops, then speak the incantation Norric taught you.
faq.q: How do you cleanse the corruption at Stendel's Pond?

faq.answer: After you complete the trial and bring proof of the cleansing to Norric in Loch Modan, he gives you the Water Totem. It grants you command over water's elemental powers.
faq.q: What do you earn for completing this quest?

faq.answer: No one knows what caused the darkness at Stendel's Pond. The pool lies unnaturally still among the bones of beasts. Did Westfall's spreading malaise poison it, or is the pond itself a fountainhead of corruption?

sections.body: Near Moonbrook, Stendel's Pond lies under a dark taint spreading across Westfall. Its waters were once clear, but now the local water spirits are silent. An old shrine stands neglected along the shore, covered in dust and cobwebs. You can seek to awaken the powers sleeping within it.
sections.title: A Spring Tainted by Shadow

sections.body: Norric in Loch Modan guides you through the rite to restore balance. At Stendel's Pond, you face the foul entity polluting the water and take its bracers to the stone shrine. There, you offer them with drops of an alchemical draught and speak the incantation. Its vapors summon a cleansed spirit, which imparts wisdom and proves you worthy of the Water Totem.
sections.title: The Rite of Cleansing

summary: You travel from Loch Modan to Westfall, where a corrupted spring has silenced the water spirits. At Stendel's Pond, you can cleanse the corruption and awaken an old shrine to seek their favor and the Water Totem.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Water
